key_insight: Pretraining a codec-avatar model at very large scale on in-the-wild data yields surprisingly strong generalization, and when fine-tuned on small high-quality studio captures it recovers studio-level fidelity—bridging the fidelity vs. generalization gap.
problem_solved: Addresses the core trade-off in 3D avatar modeling: high-fidelity multi-view studio pipelines do not generalize to real-world data at scale, while in-the-wild models generalize but lack studio-quality detail. The paper shows how large-scale pretraining can combine the strengths of both.
method: Pretrain a codec-based avatar representation on a very large, diverse in-the-wild avatar dataset to learn broadly generalizable features.
Design a compact, transferable latent (codec) and training scheme that captures identity, expression, and pose across varied conditions.
Fine-tune or adapt the pretrained model on limited multi-view studio data to regain high-fidelity reconstruction and precise control.
impact: Enables practitioners to build avatar systems that generalize to real-world inputs while achieving studio-quality detail with far less expensive capture. This reduces data collection cost and improves robustness for downstream avatar/VR/AR applications.
visual_elements: Dataset scale vs. performance chart: x-axis = dataset size (studio → in-the-wild → large-scale pretrain), y-axis = generalization/fidelity metrics, showing gains from pretraining.
Pipeline diagram: Pretrain on large in-the-wild dataset → transferable codec latent → fine-tune on small studio captures, annotated with where fidelity and generalization are gained.
Before/After gallery: side-by-side avatar reconstructions from the same real-world inputs using (a) studio-only model, (b) in-the-wild-only model, (c) large-scale pretrain + fine-tune.
Latent-space visualization (e.g., t-SNE) or bar chart of downstream improvements across tasks (identity preservation, expression accuracy, pose generalization).
paper_title: Large-scale Codec Avatars: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Large-scale Avatar Pretraining
paper_authors: Junxuan Li, Rawal Khirodkar, Chengan He, Zhongshi Jiang, Giljoo Nam
